items.quote: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. “Don’t be alarmed,” he said. “He’s alive!”
items.contrast: The young man is the person Paul declares alive, not Paul, who is the speaker and actor.
items.reason: The context of Paul embracing the young man identifies the referent of “He’s,” and verse 12 confirms that the young man was taken home alive. The question tests pronoun reference and distinguishes the speaker from the person being described.
